reason: If I saw it in a café I'd grab one can once just to see what yerba mate tastes like, but at 55 CZK it's almost double what I pay per can for Monster or Big Shock on offer, so it's not replacing my exam-night drink.
objection: 55 CZK for one can is a lot when I can get a 4-pack of Semtex on sale for not much more, and 80 mg doesn't sound like more of a kick than what I already drink.
would_change_my_mind: A multipack deal that brings it down to around 30-35 CZK a can, like the energy drink offers I already buy.
